llm.reply:
The retrieved records are ClinVar SequenceVariant entries for BRCA1 missense changes, all named on the NM_007294.4 transcript. They identify the variants but do not carry clinical significance calls, review status, or genome assembly coordinates, so they only partly answer the question.

## Variant Identifiers

Each record pairs a ClinVar identifier with an HGVS name, such as NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.4709T>C (p.Leu1570Pro) [1]. Another example is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.353T>C (p.Leu118Pro) [3]. One record, ClinVar:1010631, has no name attached [29].

## Protein Positions

The substitutions are spread across the coding sequence. Near the N-terminus is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.500C>T (p.Thr167Ile) [21]. In the central region is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.3664G>A (p.Glu1222Lys) [2]. Toward the C-terminus is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.4840C>G (p.Pro1614Ala) [30].

## Classification and Assembly

Classification evidence and assembly context are not in these records. Pathogenicity assertions, evidence criteria, and GRCh37 or GRCh38 placements would need to come from a live ClinVar lookup of these identifiers, for example ClinVar:1000183 [1].
